Gaps and implications

Your customer journey today: strong offers, but no front door that is open every day

1

You’ve run live masterclasses and challenges before. But between those dates there is no way to monetise the 95%* of your audience who aren’t ready for 3-month 1:1 coaching yet.

2

And there is no way to find out who in your audience is actually qualified for it. The free reset brings people in, but nothing sorts the curious from the ready before they reach you.

Launch-led

Your classes run on a date, then stop

Each live masterclass or challenge fills, runs and closes. Between them, the people who would have joined have nowhere to land except a free download.

No daily front door

New people only arrive when a post travels

With 45.5k followers you have reach, but it rises and falls with the algorithm. Nothing puts LIMITLESS in front of new, ready people every single day.

You do the sorting

Qualifying happens one conversation at a time

Without a step that shows who is ready, you spend time with people who loved the reset but aren’t ready to invest in 1:1 yet.

You already have the offers, the story and the stage presence. What’s missing is one always-on class that teaches, fills the membership and qualifies for 1:1 at the same time.

*The 95% figure is an industry estimate, not your data.

My recommendation

A free, always-on masterclass, fed by ads, in front of your membership and 1:1

Everything you’ve built stays, including your live events. The evergreen class becomes the front door that ads fill every day: it takes people from “Who am I now?” to a clear next chapter, offers the LIMITLESS Membership on the thank-you page, and hands the people ready for more an application for 3-month 1:1 coaching.

Opens a front door every day

Ads put the free class in front of people at a crossroads daily, whether or not you posted that morning. Every seat joins your list.

Makes the membership an easy yes

People meet the membership straight after they’ve signed up to learn from you, not from a cold scroll. The first step stays free, and the membership becomes the natural next one.

Shows who is ready for 1:1

The people who watch, stay for the Q&A and apply are the ones ready to invest. The application tells you their situation and timing before you ever get on a call.

The 95%*

Curious, not ready for 1:1 yet

They take the free class, the right ones join the LIMITLESS Membership, and everyone joins your list. Membership revenue helps cover the ad spend while they grow toward 1:1.

The qualified 5%

Ready to invest in 1:1

They attend, stay for the Q&A and apply on the replay page. The pre-call emails prepare them, so your calls are with people who already know how you work.

Does this sound familiar?

Life moved on. Now what?

  • A role, a routine or a chapter has ended, and the old version of you doesn’t quite fit any more.
  • You know you want more, but you can’t yet put words to what “more” is.
  • The confidence that used to come easily now needs a run-up.
  • You’re ready for something bold, and you’d love a plan for getting there.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in 60 minutes

Why change shakes confidence

What happens when a chapter ends, and why feeling unsure is a normal part of moving forward.

Answering “Who am I now?”

A simple exercise to get clear on your strengths, your values and what you want next.

Confidence you can build on purpose

Practical habits that help you show up as the person you’re becoming, not the one you were.

Your first bold step

How to choose the one move that gets your next chapter started this month.

Your next 90 days

A one-page plan you can start the day after the class.
